name: Z RPG
storyline:
Dragon Ball follows the adventures of Goku, a kind-hearted warrior with extraordinary strength, from his childhood to adulthood. Alongside a growing group of friends and former rivals, he travels the world in search of the seven mystical Dragon Balls, which can summon a dragon capable of granting wishes. Throughout his journey, Goku trains in martial arts, takes part in legendary tournaments and protects Earth from increasingly powerful threats.

Z RPG retells and expands the major events of Dragon Ball, connecting canonical storylines, films and TV specials with original scenarios designed to form one continuous adventure.
summary:
Z RPG is an unofficial fan-made Dragon Ball turn-based role-playing game for PC. Inspired by Dragon Ball Z: Attack of the Saiyans, Dragon Ball: Advanced Adventure and the Legacy of Goku series, it combines overworld exploration, party-based combat, side quests and story-driven progression. The game retells and expands events from the manga, anime, films and TV specials while introducing original scenarios designed to fit within the Dragon Ball universe.

"The current demo begins at the 23rd World Martial Arts Tournament and continues into the beginning of the Saiyan Saga."
